name: drifin-slot-android
description: Empacotamento Android do jogo Drifin Slot com a mesma base de corrida.

scripts.sync: npm run copy-web && npx cap sync android && node scripts/patch-android.mjs
scripts.run: npm run sync && npx cap run android
scripts.build-debug: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.build-release: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
